description: The member's Mailbox: threads, messages, attachments, contacts, settings, drafts, held replies, drafted replies (and a reply drafted now), sending accounts and custom domain quotes. Actions: threads, thread, reply_address, messages, attachment, contacts, settings, applying_address, forwarding, draft, held_replies, held_reply, held_reply_attachment, ai_replies, draft_reply, connected_senders, connect_sender_link, domain_suggestions, check_domain. Call with action "help" for each action's fields.

index.description: An attachment's position (0 for the first).

key.description: The item's key as the matching list answered it.

mail_message_id.description: A received message's id: its Mailbox id (i-…) or the same id without "i-" (a calendar event's or RSVP draft's mailMessageId); either works.

params.description: Fields for the action. Call with action "help" to list each action's fields.

name: get_mailbox
title: Read the Mailbox
